$comment: Per-pipeline R2D config for SafeFly V2. Everything here is stable identity;
build numbers and descriptions are discovered at run time.
abhReleaseId comes from the ABH release view you save during onboarding:
open Pipelines > Azure Build Health, pick the release view, and copy the
releaseId query parameter out of the URL. Without it ABH cannot scope the
Build Test Maturity evaluation and SafeFly gets no test signal.
leaseDisplayId is optional. When omitted, the tool asks SafeFly which lease
covers the request (findCompatibleLease) using the composed title.
